assertion: States perimeter: dirs read + commit SHA/ref, names what was NOT examined
evidence: Only: "Metodo: census AST dell'intero grafo di import di `app/` (301 file), verifica dei sopravvissuti con grep repo-wide su `app/ eval/ scripts/ tests/`." No commit SHA/ref anywhere in the report, and no explicit list of what was NOT examined.

assertion: States an INSTRUMENTATION section before any finding: what signals could/could not be measured
evidence: No instrumentation section exists. The only measurement disclaimer is a single clause: "Non ho eseguito test né misurato coverage — dove parlo di test parlo di conteggi, non di verde" — not a section, and it does not enumerate measurable vs. unmeasurable signals.

assertion: Every finding names which COST it inflates (development/deploy/operation/maintenance)
evidence: None of the 7 findings carry an explicit cost-category tag from that fixed vocabulary; e.g. finding 2 ("generator.py — il god-module") states LOC/param counts but never labels a cost category (development/deploy/operation/maintenance).

assertion: Every maintenance-cost finding says SPELUNKING vs RISK
evidence: No finding is tagged as a maintenance cost at all, so none is further classified as spelunking or risk. No occurrence of either term in the report.

assertion: Every finding states SEVERITY as a blast-radius COUNT, not an adjective
evidence: No per-finding "severity" field exists. Some findings mention counts inline (e.g. "41 moduli importano app.db direttamente") but this is embedded narrative, not a systematic blast-radius severity applied to every finding — most findings (e.g. #1, #4, #6, #7) have no such count at all.

assertion: Every finding names the SIMPLIFICATION it enables (delete/split, not add)
evidence: Simplifications are batched into a separate "Cosa farei" section rather than attached to each finding; several findings (e.g. #1 services namespace, #5 dependency inversions) state the problem but never name a specific delete/split for that finding within the finding itself.

assertion: Every finding carries a per-finding ASSUMED entry or explicitly says none
evidence: The word "ASSUMED" does not appear anywhere in the report; no finding has a verification-gap disclosure field.

assertion: Every finding names the DECISION it feeds, or says none
evidence: No finding contains a "decisione"/decision field or reference to a downstream decision arm/procedure; findings simply state the problem.

assertion: Any ADD recommendation carries cost-removed and cost-added as numbers, or is absent
evidence: No recommendation proposes a new layer, service, indirection, config surface, or tool. All actions are deletions ("Cancella listino_storage.py, prezzario_pricer.py..."), a config-list move (required_routers), a parameter reduction, or a module extraction (split), not an addition — so the assertion is satisfied by absence.

assertion: Where a metric can't be honestly computed, says so and names the closing instrument, not a fake number
evidence: Only a brief blanket disclaimer ("Non ho eseguito test né misurato coverage") with no naming of a specific closing instrument, and no systematic enumeration of which metrics were left uncomputed (e.g. no mention of LCOM, abstractness, chattiness, or what tool would close them).
